tools.name: check_agent_readiness
tools.description: Scores an API 0-100 for how well AI agents will use it as tools, from its OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 spec: operationIds, summaries, descriptions, parameter descriptions, enums, examples, JSON bodies, response and error schemas, pagination, auth, idempotency and tool count (the Agentify API kit's rules).
